resources.string: Tap empty sky to show or hide the reticle and icons together.
Double-tap empty sky to pause or resume time.
Paused time always shows an orange date, clock and UTC offset, with a pause symbol.
Live time resumes at now; custom dates, times or speeds continue from the held instant.
Point bubbles place time and T together with a middle dot, including photos and panoramas.
Dated comparison bubbles separate the object heading from the date, with wrapped long text.
